newsitem.title: USA: Miltope Group unit gets $4.6 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Miltope Group unit gets $4.6 mln order.

text.p: A unit of Miltope Group Inc said on Wednesday it received an additional $4.6 million order from a Luxembourg based telecommunications company to manufacture ruggedized Internet terminals for commercial use in Europe and the United States.
Since July 1996, Miltope has received orders totaling $7.7 million for the new product.
The terminals will be installed in public areas to provide Internet access for people away from their home or office, the company said.
It did not name the Luxembourg company.
Miltope Group Inc. is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and testing of computers and computer peripheral equipment that must operate under demanding environmental conditions.
